title: State-adapted generalized mean-field projections for Pauli propagation of Heisenberg dynamics
summary: The Heisenberg picture can make quantum many-body simulation efficient when evolved observables admit compact operator representation within low-dimensional structures. Conventional Pauli-string propagation and truncation techniques exploit this structure, but in coherent Hamiltonian dynamics their error control is often heuristic and their stability can be poor. We introduce a state-adapted Krylov framework based on geometric generalized mean-field projections of many-body observables onto low-body operator subspaces.
